implementation_strategy: Execute scenario_A_recommended within the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 contract: use the single hosted LLM API (gpt-5-mini) for all generation and repair calls; run deterministic text→CLI parsing, verifier JSON parsing, emulator (Mininet) tests, and repair-prompt construction inside CPU Docker containers. All scoring, flagging, selection, and exclusion are deterministic code run inside Docker. No human annotation or adjudication.
public_resources: Dockerfile and CPU Docker images for verifier and emulator
deterministic CLI parser and AST library (regex+AST)
snapshot crawler and intent corpus scripts (published)
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic crawler snapshot of public NetOps intents (URIs + hash). Stratified sampling fixed pre-freeze: Cisco=34, Juniper=33, Arista=33. Publish full URI list and hash snapshot.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic pipelines: (1) prompt templates fixed at preregistration; (2) LLM output → regex-based parser → vendor CLI AST → canonicalized CLI; (3) verifier JSON error reports produced by rule engine; (4) repair prompts deterministically interpolated from verifier JSON and prior config; (5) emulator test scripts map verifier flags to deterministic tests.
randomisation_plan: Stratified deterministic RNG (seed=42) used only for audit-sample selection and internal non-analytic ordering. Vendor quotas preserved; seed fixed and published.
caching_plan: Deterministic hash-based caching of (prompt, seed) → LLM response, verifier JSON, and emulator logs. Cache reused across identical inputs to avoid redundant hosted calls. Cache storage in Docker volume and published with hashes.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated infrastructure-retry policy: for infrastructure faults, perform up to 2 automated full-task re-executions (same seed/config). Per-call retries limited to 1 attempt. If artifacts remain unavailable after retries the intent is recorded as missing and excluded from confirmatory paired analysis per preregistration; sensitivity analyses (complete-case and two worst-case imputations) will be run. All failures logged with deterministic failure codes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent record contains intent_id, vendor, baseline_config (LLM output), baseline_verifier_report (JSON), baseline_emulator_log, guarded_initial_config, guarded_verifier_report, guarded_repair_config, guarded_emulator_log, violation_binary_flags (verifier+emulator), latency_proxies, contamination_flags, execution_hashes.
estimated_compute_notes: No local GPU available; use hosted LLM API (gpt-5-mini) for generation and repairs. Emulation and verification run in CPU Docker containers (Mininet). Estimated model calls = 100 initial generation calls + estimated 50 repair calls = 150; maximum_model_calls = 100*2 = 200. Wall-clock execution planned within the 7‑day limit using 4 batches on CPU runners and parallel hosted API quota; all batch sizes and call counts adhere to the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 contract.
